lines.en: I shift one foot at a time. Slowly.

lines.zh: 瘦长的身子，在茂林里穿行。
lines.en: A thin long body threading the overgrowth.
I lower my head and sniff the roots.
Every step takes some thinking.

lines.zh: 脚下的腐叶，陷进去半寸。
lines.en: Leaf litter gives half an inch underfoot.
I head where the mosquitoes are thick.

lines.zh: 我跟在一只后面，很久了。
lines.en: I've been trailing one for a while.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，脖子往前探。
lines.en: Step by step, neck stretching forward.
A vine in the way. I push it aside.

lines.zh: 我的头往前伸，脖子很长。
lines.en: My head reaches forward. Long neck.
Here the growth is taller than I am.

lines.zh: 我绕过一株带刺的植物。
lines.en: I go round a thorned plant.

lines.zh: 我保持着姿势，像棵绿树。
lines.en: I hold still, like a green tree.
This thin, hiding is easy.
I'm listening for wings.

lines.zh: 茂林里潮得很，我不介意。
lines.en: The overgrowth is damp. I don't mind.

lines.zh: 我的嘴很长，专门用来抓。
lines.en: My jaw is long. Made for catching.
A mosquito just flew past.
I roll my eye slowly.
The leaves here have toothed edges.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候，像一根枯枝。
lines.en: Still like this, I look like dead wood.
Too slow to chase anything that flies.

lines.zh: 你比我高一点，但没比我壮。
lines.en: You're a bit taller. Not sturdier.
I won't start anything.
Don't start anything with me either.
I look at you and you stop moving.
I'm measuring the distance to leap.
Is one leap enough.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，不太像吃的。
lines.en: You don't smell like food.
You're not food. Then never mind.
I draw my head back slowly.
You back away slowly too.
I flinched and my neck bent.

lines.zh: 这么瘦的身子，挨不住几下。
lines.en: A body this thin can't take much.
Startled, I dart about.
I hide behind the vines.
My ribs keep aching.
I sink into the grass and wait out the pain.
Stop. I'll just run.
My thin legs quiver; I nearly collapse.

lines.zh: 这一下，我记住了这个方向。
lines.en: Now I know which way that came from.
This place — I'm leaving.
I don't really eat this.

lines.zh: 不合口味，我扭头找蚊子。
lines.en: Not my taste; I turn away for mosquitoes.
I only want things that fly.
It must fly. It must be alive.
That's too big to swallow.
Your arm will tire holding it up.
Put it down. I'll consider it.
I'll wait for it to move.
If it doesn't move, I won't eat it.
Not worth the effort.
One touch and I sprang away.
I'm thin. A knock could snap me.

lines.zh: 我瘦得没分量，一撞就退。
lines.en: I'm thin and light; one bump pushes me back.
I dodge quickly. Faster than I walk.

lines.zh: 别挤，我只站得下一只脚。
lines.en: Don't crowd. I've room for one foot.
Your knee met my ribs.

lines.zh: 我歪了，缓了缓才正过来。
lines.en: I tilted and took a moment to right myself.
Step back. I need to pass.
I've marked that bump.
That one. Don't do it again.
Something like me isn't good at this.

lines.zh: 我们站在一起，像两根枯枝。
lines.en: Side by side, we look like two dead sticks.
You're a little thinner than me.
We could stand like this a long time.

lines.zh: 我没力气说什么好听的。
lines.en: I've no strength for pretty words.

lines.zh: 有蚊子飞过来，我抓给你。
lines.en: A mosquito's coming. I'll catch it for you.

lines.zh: 这一片茂林，够我们两个。
lines.en: This overgrowth is enough for two.
Take your time. I'm in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我们脖子碰了碰，算答应。
lines.en: Our necks touch — that's a yes.
Let's stay like this.
I lower my head and take it in my jaw.
So light I barely feel it.
I flick it aside.
It lies across my path.
Too hard — my teeth aren't made for this.
Yours. I leave it.
I push it ahead of me.
A pile on the ground. I step over it.
Carrying it makes my neck heavier.
Down it goes. I don't need it.
Wings. Very close.

lines.zh: 脖子太长，转头要一会儿。
lines.en: My neck is long; turning takes a while.
It settled on a leaf.
It turned its back; I stretch my neck.
Distance measured. Jumping.
I crouch low, like a dead branch.
I've loaded my hind legs.
This leap must be accurate.
This lunge, now.
Don't let it take off.
One leap. Out.
Missed. That's all right.
It'll come back.
One more breath and it will move.
I'll catch one eventually.
For one mosquito, I can wait.
I'm slow, but my teeth are long.
It hasn't flown off.
My head stays aimed at it.
A little closer and I can reach.
It moved. I stop.
Wait for it to settle.
My jaw is already open.

lines.zh: 它的味道顺着风飘过来。
lines.en: Its scent drifts over on the wind.
Hold steady. That will do.
This lunge will land.

lines.zh: 后腿蓄力，我准备扑过去。
lines.en: My hind legs coil; I get ready to leap.
It's landed again.
This is what I waited for.
I jumped. I've got it.
Mouth open, I wait for it to come close.
One mouthful keeps me going.
That'll last me a while.
Now for the next one.
Plenty of mosquitoes in the overgrowth.
In this wood I won't starve.
I leap up and lunge.
That lunge is far faster than my walk.
The jaw opens and closes fast.
My teeth sink in and I thrash.
Thin, but not weak.
It struggled twice. I tightened.

lines.zh: 这一下，是我唯一快的时刻。
lines.en: That's the only moment I'm fast.
After landing I'm slow again.
Don't retreat too far.
Too far and I can't reach.

lines.zh: 我的下一扑，比刚才更快。
lines.en: My next lunge will be quicker.
I pin it and drive my jaw down.
Once I have it, I shake my head.
That used my whole body.
I land and my knees give.
It still struggles. I bite harder.
My lunge went wide a little.
Again. I still have strength.
That was the last one.
I release and step back.
I squeeze out from the vines.
A long thin body, folded twice.
The air in the overgrowth is heavy.
I straighten. A little taller than the growth.
I turn my head slowly and look around.
Toothed leaf edges. I keep clear.
There's the sound of wings.
Slow, but I can still lunge.

lines.zh: 肚子空了，我从灌木里出来。
lines.en: My belly is empty; I come out of the brush.
But I'm not hurrying at all.
One will always fly over.

lines.zh: 我仰起头，慢慢地把脖子伸直。
lines.en: I raise my head and stretch my neck out straight.

lines.zh: 火燎过来，我的皮皱起来。
lines.en: Fire swept in and my hide puckered.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下，落地时折了一下。
lines.en: I fell from height and folded on landing.
Water rises. I'm a poor swimmer.
The blast threw me into the vines.
Something's lodged in my hind leg.
A flash and all my strength went.
Three days without catching a mosquito.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我整个弹起来。
lines.en: Lightning struck and I jumped out of my skin.
No vines here. No grass.
